# 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(hdm)
library(pROC)
library(knitr)

```

# 2. Load Data

```{r}
macro <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_clean_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

macro_fin <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_financial_clean_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

dim(macro)
dim(macro_fin)
#names(macro)
#names(macro_fin)

# Check if recession indicator exists
"USREC" %in% names(macro)
"USREC" %in% names(macro_fin)

# Check date ranges
range(macro$sasdate)
range(macro_fin$sasdate)

# Check missing values
sum(is.na(macro))
sum(is.na(macro_fin))
```
#3. EDA; Checking of recessions (can move to seperate Rmd downstream)
```{r}
recession_data <- macro_fin %>%
  select(sasdate, USREC) %>%
  arrange(sasdate) %>%
  mutate(
    recession_start = USREC == 1 & lag(USREC, default = 0) == 0,
    recession_id = cumsum(recession_start)
  ) %>%
  filter(USREC == 1) %>%
  group_by(recession_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_date = min(sasdate),
    end_date = max(sasdate),
    duration_months = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-recession_id)

print(recession_data)

# recommended cutoff, referenced from research papers
cutoff <- as.Date("1986-01-01")

recession_data %>%
  mutate(
    sample = case_when(
      end_date < cutoff ~ "Training",
      start_date >= cutoff ~ "Testing",
      TRUE ~ "Crosses cutoff"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(start_date, end_date, duration_months, sample)
```
